identity: VU Dutch full-time Sociology BSc, CROHO 56601, annual basis 2026–2027.
curriculum: The adopted 2026–2027 OER and annual VU study guide agree on a full-time Dutch-taught 180 EC degree with no formal route. The first year has ten 6 EC units. The second year has eight fixed units and two 6 EC choices. The OER annual timetable and the Study Guide data place Beyond Gender Inequalities and AI & Society first in their respective menus; the exact module entries confirm both selections. Year three consists of 30 EC open study, 6 EC intervention evaluation, 6 EC philosophy of science and an 18 EC individual thesis. The 0 EC language test and three mentorship entries add no credits.
progression: OER Article 9.1 requires participation in statistics before Big Data and in Big Data before Network and Social Media Analysis. Intervention evaluation requires passing statistics and Social Inequality 2 and participating in Interpretive Research. The thesis requires 90 EC from Years 1–2 and participation in intervention evaluation. The exact thesis description confirms a supervised individual research project. The Dutch test or remediation gates the Project 1 grade. Article 12.1 allows approved courses, a minor, internship or study abroad, with level and approval conditions. The four projects involve external partners and distinct policy, research, social enterprise and consultancy roles.
